name: wechat-mp/article-detail
description: Get a WeChat Official Account article by URL with selectable plain-text or rich-text content mode. Use it to collect a known article in the preferred representation for reading, extraction, or storage.

mode.description: Article body format. TEXT returns plain text, and RICH_TEXT returns rich text when supported.

articleUrl.description: WeChat Official Account article URL used to fetch article detail content and metadata.

readme:
# WeChat MP Article Details API Returns the content and metadata of one WeChat Official Account article. It needs the article URL as `articleUrl`, and an optional `mode` of `TEXT` or `RICH_TEXT` to choose the body format. ## Use cases - Archive the full body and images of a known article for storage or offline reading. - Extract article text for translation, summarization, or keyword analysis. - Identify the publishing account of an article from its `nick_name`, `alias` and `biz` values. - Collect the image URLs of an article to download its pictures. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/wechat-mp/article-detail" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"articleUrl": "http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MjM5NzI3NDg4MA==&mid=2659064933&idx=1&sn=c536f78d7358bc2dfe90cde700e21d55&chksm=bc881cb3f28a27f35e0711803b28d8110305cfc1b8beb651674e1aa7870ddf963c658f4dc19a&scene=7#rd"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `articleUrl` | string | Yes | WeChat Official Account article URL used to fetch article detail content and metadata. | | `mode` | string | No | Article body format. TEXT returns plain text, and RICH_TEXT returns rich text when supported. | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "alias": "people_rmw", "app_id": "wx020d85a0aef80286", "appmsg_link": "", "author": "人民网", "biz": "MjM5NzI3NDg4MA==", "cdn_url": "https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/sz_mmbiz_jpg/XvpojIRrhdsyicO44PY4KBDO38CdYO8ibR6G1vDpBibT3…", "cdn_url_16_9": "", "cdn_url_1_1": "https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_jpg/XvpojIRrhdtYoKJAt9gpOfEewclvkplGicoF0BKYP99k961i…", "cdn_url_235_1": "https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/sz_mmbiz_jpg/XvpojIRrhdsyicO44PY4KBDO38CdYO8ibR6G1vDpBibT3…", "claim_source_info": { "aigc_type": "", "aigc_wording": "", "claim_source": "1", "claim_source_type": "", "media_source_type_info": { "biz_headimgurl": "", "biz_link_url": "", "biz_nickname": "", "media_source_from": "", "news_position_info": { "city": "", "country": "", "province": "" }, "news_time": "", "other_from_account": "" } }, "collect_count": -1, "comment_count": -1 } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `content` | Article body. In the sample response it holds HTML-style markup with `

` and `` tags. | | `content_multi_text` | Another form of the article body, with inline styles and links in HTML-style markup. | | `author` | Author name shown on the article. | | `nick_name / alias / biz / app_id` | Identifiers of the Official Account that published the article: display name, account alias, `biz` ID and app ID. | | `create_time / create_time_str / pubtime` | Publish time of the article. `create_time` and `pubtime` use the format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. `create_time_str` stops at minutes. | | `mid / idx / hashid` | Article identifiers. `mid` is the message ID, `idx` is the article position in that message, and `hashid` matches the `sn` value in the URL. | | `picture_page_info_list[].cdn_url` | Image URL for each picture found in the article. | | `picture_page_info_list[].width / picture_page_info_list[].height` | Dimensions of each picture. | | `cdn_url / cdn_url_1_1 / cdn_url_235_1` | Cover image URLs in different aspect ratios. Some ratios can be empty strings. | | `ip_wording / provinceName / countryName` | Location text shown for the article, such as province and country. | | `read / comment_count / share_count / collect_count / looking` | Engagement counters. The sample returns `-1` for all of them, so use the metrics API for these numbers. | ## Notes - Copy `articleUrl` from a WeChat article link. The sample URL contains the `__biz`, `mid`, `idx` and `sn` parameters, which match `biz`, `mid`, `idx` and `hashid` in the response. - Set `mode` to `RICH_TEXT` to ask for rich text. The default is `TEXT`. - For view and like counts, call [WeChat MP Article Metrics](/apis/wechat-mp/article-metrics). For reader comments, call [WeChat MP Article Comments](/apis/wechat-mp/article-comment). - A newer version of this endpoint is available as [WeChat MP Article Detail (H5, Recommended)](/apis/wechat-mp/v2/article-detail-h5). ## Pricing $0.021429 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged.
